text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On this day, Kawakami Princess
came to fulfill that promise.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Looks like you've got a better look on your face now.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Yes, I have no openings at present. If we're gonna do this, I'm going in seriously strong and bashing them flat.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hmph, sharp-tongued as ever, I see...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"And I will cherish this opportunity to learn from you
and use it to further my own growth."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Well, that's enough for greetings.
Hey there, all my lovely faaans!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Hey, you...
Why did you get off the stage...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying so, Kawakami Princess exchanged high-fives,
one after another, with the fans gathered near the paddock.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Haha, Princess—! Over here too—!
Ugh, what is with that girl... Unbelievable...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha!
That's just the kind of Umamusume Kawakami is!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for the cheers!
I'll shine brighter and brighter!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Be true to yourselves and aim for your ideals!
Now then, today's competing princesses—
